standard: ASHRAE Fundamentals 2017 (SI Edition), Chapter 21 Duct Design, Table 12 "Recommended Maximum Airflow Velocities to Achieve Specified Acoustic Design Criteria"
source: Transcribed directly from Table 12, p.21.22. Adapted by ASHRAE from Table 9 in Chapter 48 of the 2015 ASHRAE Handbook-HVAC Applications and Schaffer (2011).
note: Purpose is noise control, not code compliance - these are acoustic design targets (NC/RC = Noise Criteria / Room Criteria rating), not structural or energy-code velocity limits. A design exceeding these values is not necessarily non-compliant with any code, but risks objectionable duct noise in the adjoining occupied space.
